description: Cost attribution by template hash. Shows which compact patterns consume the most ingest CPU and bytes, and which patterns are growing fastest. Requires the tenx-for-clickhouse schema (https://github.com/log-10x/clickhouse-app) and a ClickHouse data source configured as the default.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS value FROM ${database}.encoded_events WHERE $__timeFilter(JSONExtractInt(raw, 'time'))
SELECT sum(length(raw)) AS value FROM ${database}.encoded_events WHERE $__timeFilter(JSONExtractInt(raw, 'time'))
SELECT uniq(templateHash) AS value FROM ${database}.encoded_events WHERE $__timeFilter(JSONExtractInt(raw, 'time')) AND templateHash != ''

SELECT e.templateHash AS templateHash, coalesce(t.template, '(template missing)') AS template, count() AS events, sum(length(e.raw)) AS bytes, any(e.container) AS sampleContainer FROM ${database}.encoded_events AS e LEFT JOIN ${database}.templates AS t USING (templateHash) WHERE $__timeFilter(JSONExtractInt(e.raw, 'time')) AND e.templateHash != '' GROUP BY e.templateHash, t.template ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT $__timeInterval(toDateTime(JSONExtractInt(raw, 'time'))) AS t, container, count() AS events FROM ${database}.encoded_events WHERE $__timeFilter(JSONExtractInt(raw, 'time')) AND container != '' GROUP BY t, container ORDER BY t

WITH top AS (SELECT templateHash FROM ${database}.encoded_events WHERE $__timeFilter(JSONExtractInt(raw, 'time')) AND templateHash != '' GROUP BY templateHash ORDER BY count() DESC LIMIT 5) SELECT $__timeInterval(toDateTime(JSONExtractInt(e.raw, 'time'))) AS t, e.templateHash AS templateHash, count() AS events FROM ${database}.encoded_events AS e INNER JOIN top USING (templateHash) WHERE $__timeFilter(JSONExtractInt(e.raw, 'time')) GROUP BY t, e.templateHash ORDER BY t

title: 10x — Template cost attribution
